title: Rapid mixing of graph switches
coordinate: The exponent in the mixing time. The published bound is 2n^8 for every graphical degree sequence.
note: The same manuscript gives an exactly uniform sampler with expected polynomial bit running time. That sampler is a separate claim from the mixing exponent.

try.hint: A later record is a smaller proven exponent. Keep the leading factor 2 out of this field. The published degree is 8, and the Fourier reader only accepts a saving strictly between 0 and 1, so this page can name a repository without plotting that integer.

source.title: Polynomial mixing of the switch chain for every graphical degree sequence
